sample_and_taxonomy.method: Deliberate topic/title/category coverage with publisher balancing and negative controls; 12 targeted gap-check examples added to initial 80. Bounded source excerpts, not a statistical prevalence/accuracy sample.

sample_and_taxonomy.prompting_structured_outputs: Application-engineering subtopics of AI Applications in the current ten-topic proposal, not an eleventh topic.
important_boundaries: Code-model release integrated into a coding workflow -> AI Coding; neural training mathematics -> Models & Research; coding-vendor GPU kernels -> Infrastructure.
Retrieval-specific embeddings remain RAG; model benchmarks incidental to a release do not automatically make QA.
A financing story about a coding company -> Business & Industry; a government-user product release is not automatically Policy.
AI laws/standards/governance obligations -> Policy; implementation of monitoring/defences -> QA or Security when central.
AI cyber/biosecurity/alignment risks -> Security & Safety; generic non-AI cyber/news remains outside admission.
Mixed newsletters with no clear primary subject can remain unclassified; collect boundary cases instead of forcing labels.
sample_and_taxonomy.legacy_compatibility: Keep old Security and Business & Product values readable/filterable; do not mechanically map Business & Product to one new label or rewrite frozen reports.
